items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: Like I played actually opposite Bobby Short in his first gig at the — it wasn’t the Carlyle then it was the Beverly Hotel, and I was the other, the off piano.

ctx.x: What makes the music business something that you describe as being a survivor of?

Well let’s see — I know too many people who haven’t survived. I was very fortunate because I played piano. I could play piano and sing. And so when I came to New York I didn’t have to wait tables. I’ve done nothing in my life but music. And then the music business began, which is first playing in clubs, some lovely ones. Like I played actually opposite Bobby Short in his first gig at the — it wasn’t the Carlyle then it was the Beverly Hotel, and I was the other, the off piano. And I sat there writing names of…
Would you say that music chose you as opposed to the other way around?
